newsitem.title: USA: USAIR details support for suit vs BA, AMR.
newsitem.headline: USAIR details support for suit vs BA, AMR.

text.p: USAir said on Tuesday that it has served papers to British Airways and American Airlines that provide legal and factual details supporting its suit against them.
The papers were provided after a U.S. District Court judge on Friday granted USAir's request to move ahead with discovery in the case, USAir said.
A hearing is scheduled for October 25 in the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York.
USAir provided the papers after American Airlines and British Airways asked federal judges to dimiss USAir's suit.

American Airlines and British Airways are seeking to integrate their transatlantic cargo and passenger services in an alliance that has drawn criticism from competitors, including USAir, which is 24.6 percent owned by British Airways.
USAir's suit alleges that the proposed alliance would undermine USAir's agreement with the British carrier and competition in the U.S. and British markets.
